title: Stress management
learning_outcomes: Explain acute and chronic stress in the context of stress management.
Compare and distinguish demands and resources in the context of stress management.
Apply coping choices in the context of stress management.
Evaluate and justify decisions about escalation in the context of stress management.

lessons.title: Acute and chronic stress
lessons.outcome: Explain acute and chronic stress in the context of stress management.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving acute and chronic stress; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to demand-resource audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain acute and chronic stress from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of acute and chronic stress; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Demands and resources
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish demands and resources in the context of stress management.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving demands and resources; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to demand-resource audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain demands and resources from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of demands and resources; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Coping choices
lessons.outcome: Apply coping choices in the context of stress management.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving coping choices; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to demand-resource audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain coping choices from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of coping choices; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Escalation
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about escalation in the context of stress management.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving escalation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to demand-resource audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain escalation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of escalation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of acute and chronic stress; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of demands and resources; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of coping choices; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of escalation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
